properties.name: EXPECTATION GAP, by design (code read, main 983811cae): create_nodes and create_node never run the near-match check (search_first has 7 call sites, all typed constructors), as cap:search-first-at-the-tool deliberately says ("BULK PATHS ARE UNAFFECTED"); the defect is that neither the tool description nor its reply says no check ran, so a chat reads silence as "nothing close"
properties.statement:
OBSERVED (sinogram trial, 2026-10-27): create_nodes wrote nodes with no near-match check, while a later add_decision flagged overlap with the agent's own related prediction nodes.

PRECEDENT: cap:search-first-at-the-tool: "BULK PATHS ARE UNAFFECTED: genesis, create_nodes and import_graph do not route through these tools, so seeding many similar nodes at once still works." Since 2026-10-17 a cross-type match is a NOTE, not a refusal (dec:idea-a-cross-type-near-match-is-a-note-and-only-a-same-type-one-refuses). dec:idea-a-bulk-matcher-says-which-of-a-list-of-texts-the-design-already-holds (settled 10-13) is the read-only bulk check.

MEASURED at main 983811cae: `git grep "search_first("` finds 7 call sites, all in tools/capture.rs (the typed constructors, add_decision at line ~3794); none in tools/query.rs, where create_node and create_nodes live. create_nodes' description ("Create or update MANY nodes in one call ... ALL OF IT OR NONE OF IT") says nothing about the check. SearchFirst's own doc invokes req:no-silent-fallback: an empty list must not mean both "nothing similar" and "I could not look".

CANDIDATES: (1) the generic path skips the guard by design. HOLDS. (2) add_decision's flag was a false positive. REFUTED as a defect: the matches were the agent's own related Requirements, of another type, so a note is the designed answer, and linking a Decision to its predictions is right. (3) Outside reflow2: flo2's door dropped a near_matches block from create_nodes' reply. REFUTED: the block is never built on that path. (4) The trial misread which call checked. Cannot be excluded; the asymmetry is real either way.

CLASS: a deliberate exemption that is silent at the tool, so the reader cannot tell "checked, nothing close" from "not checked".

FIX, ranked: (a) create_nodes' reply (and create_node's) carries one line: "no near-match check runs on this path; to check, call <the bulk matcher read> with these names" and the description says the same; pinned by a test that the reply names it; (b) run the check per item as a NOTE only (never a refusal), keeping bulk seeding unblocked; cost to measure first, as the 10-13 decision asks; (c) leave it. NOT ESTABLISHED: which node types the trial wrote through create_nodes, and whether any was a real near-duplicate. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_018ibUbMKCS1yK5W17cncp9P
